payload.body: Schema half DONE + on PR #8 (99e0b79): crates/frick-server/src/calls/schema.rs ports call-schema.ts — CallRoom/CallInvite/CallParticipant object defs, the 7 CallEventStream events, the stream, and the WebRTCSignal signal; call_*_defs(id_base) for splicing + build_call_schema(). 3 tests (validates, id_base offsets, id-less CallRoom). REMAINING: the CallCommand frame (21) -> control-plane handler -> CallCommandResult (22) routing, which pairs with the FR-283 control plane.
